reason: A CLI utility for capturing, inspecting, planning, applying, and verifying reproducible DeepSeek Harness plugin environments and portable profile configuration.

summaries.zh: 用于捕获、检查、规划、应用和验证可复现的 DeepSeek Harness 插件环境及可移植配置的命令行工具。
summaries.en: A command-line tool for capturing, inspecting, planning, applying, and verifying reproducible DeepSeek Harness plugin environments and portable profile configuration.

capabilities: Reads and validates local or HTTPS Stackfiles
Compares declared environments with target profiles
Writes profile bundles and portable configuration when explicitly applying a reviewed plan
Installs or updates declared plugin packages during apply
Creates backups and restores profile files after verification failure
Exposes a read-only stack inspection tool
